title: Runbook
description: An operational procedure for one service, written before it is needed and tested on a schedule. It lives in docs/runbooks/<id>.md; `aidd doctor` warns when `last_tested` is older than `runbook_max_age_days`.

title.description: One line: what the procedure does, such as "Fail over the orders database".

service.description: The service or system the runbook operates.

owner_team.description: The team that keeps the runbook current and answers its escalation.

last_tested.description: The day a person last ran the procedure end to end, in a drill or for real. Absent means never tested.

status.description: draft: written, not yet trusted. active: the procedure on-call follows. retired: kept for history; `aidd doctor` no longer checks its age.
